generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Estimate rates are excluding GST as per Common SR 2023-24 continued to 2026-27 and prevailing GST (18% of Amount Put to tender) amount is kept in the form of Lump sum in sanctioned estimate according to guidelines in Common SR 2023-24 (As per the circular from Govt of Karnataka no.12/2024 Bengaluru dt:09.08.2024). Therefore, Amount put to Tender and ECV amounts are excluding GST even though it is showing inclusive Tax in Draft Tender Schedule Process. Hence, GST will be paid separately for the quoted amount accordingly. The bidder has to quote the rate exclusive of GST and to submit a declaration which is duly signed by the bidder along with their tender proposal.
The contractor shall submit the details of technical staff employed by him.
The employer reserves the rights to reject one or all tenders without assigning any reason.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing E- procurement portal.
Contractors should be registered with KPWD Class - III and above Registration and the tenderer should submit the Registration Certificate along with technical bid.
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected.

All the scanned documents pertaining to bidder to be uploaded shall be in original and same originals should be produced to the Executive Engineer (at the time of Technical Bid Opening) who reserves right to verify the original documents before approval.
Contractors should follow strictly prevailing rules of labour act.

The Item rates quoted shall include cost of Royalty charges on construction materials and other taxes as per rates provided in prevailing Govt orders at the time of execution and including cost and conveyance of all materials curing, loading and unloading with all lead and lifts, labour, hire charges of machineries and equipment etc., complete and all other incidental charges. All the items shall be executed as directed by the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

All materials required for this work shall be procured by the bidder himself and should be got tested by the quality control authorities at his own cost before use on the work. Department will not supply any materials.

Materials like bitumen, steel,cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should get tested by the quality control authority at his cost before used on the work.

All documents should be uploaded by the contractor is to be attested by the authorized notary or not below the rank of Executive Engineer and should be produced for verification at any stage of process as and when sought for .Failure to produce original documents leads to rejection of Tender.
Units, Rates and Prices shall be quoted by the tender in Indian Rupees only
For maintenance type of work the contractor should maintain the building for one year (APRIL 2026 TO MARCH 2027)
Contractors should have Registration of GST, Employers Provident Fund and tenderer should submit Registration Certificate along with technical bid.
Payment of EMD of Rs. 28,200.00 shall be through E payment

The successful bidder has to follow the prevailing Government orders regarding Royalty Charges. The Contractor has to submit MDP Certificate along with the running contractor bills. Otherwise Department will take necessary action as per the Government Orders/Circulars.
Work reserved to ST Category

technicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Section 2 ITT 3.2 - To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years (i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-2026) (b) Should satisfactory completed as a prime contractor for at least any construction work to an extent of 25% of the cost of the work. Rs. 7.04Lakhs

3.3 Assessed available tender capacity - (AxNx5-B) where A -Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to current financial year price level)(FY in which tenders are invited) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N - Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B - Value, at Current Financial year (FY in which tenders are invited) price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during 12 months. (Period of completion of the works for which tenders are invited)

Section 2 ITT 3.2 To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years (i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26) (a) achieved in at least One financial years a minimum financial turnover (in all classes of civil engineering works only) of Rs 28.14 LAKHS (usually not less than two times the estimated annual payments under this contract)

itemList.description: External sweeping   and terrace cleaning -   Cleaning of outer periphery like roads footpaths curb stones terrace including removing grass dust etc., to the nearest garbage pit using suitable coconut broomstic,bombay broomstick, squezers /wipers /rubberbru ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials all lead and lift, loading and unloading, hire charges of machinery and equipments, transportation charges labour charges and all other incidental charges etc., complete as per standard technical detailed specification and as per approved design and drawing and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.

Cleaning surface drains including removing of dirt dust etc., using suitrable soap powder, coconut broomstick, squeezers / wipers/ rubber brushes, coir  brushes,  plastric  brushjes,  mugs,  booster  pumps  with  portable arrangement, hose pipe etc., complete ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials all lead and lift, loading and unloading, hire charges of machinery and equipments, transportation charges labour charges and all other incidental charges etc., complete as per standard technical detailed specification and as per approved design and drawing and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.

Cleaning of office floors, toilet floors, corridors, lobbies, partitions, storage units,  furnitures,electrical  &  electronic  equipments,  doors,  windows, curtains, blinds etc., including cleaning of dust, etc., using suitable bombay broom stick, squezers ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials all lead and lift, loading and unloading, hire charges of machinery and equipments, transportation charges labour charges and all other incidental charges etc., complete as per standard technical detailed specification and as per approved design and drawing and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.

Clearing    and    grubbing    road    land    including    uprooting    rank vegetation,  grass,  bushes,  shrubs,  saplings  and  trees  girth  up  to 300  mm,  removal  of  stumps  of  trees  cut  earlier  and  disposal  of unserviceable  materials  and  stacking  of  serviceable  material  to be used or auctioned,  including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer - In area of light jungle ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials all lead and lift, loading and unloading, hire charges of machinery and equipments, transportation charges labour charges and all other incidental charges etc., complete as per standard technical detailed specification and as per approved design and drawing and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.

Cleaning of under ground sump, Over Head R.C.C. Tank ( independent staging)  including  disposal  of  slit  and  rubbish,  all  as  per  direction  of Engineer-in-Charge. The cleaning shall consist  following operations:-
Tank shall be emptied of water by pumping & bottom shall be  cleaned of silt and other  deposits.
Entire surface area of the sump shall then scrubbed thoroughly with wire brush etc. and pressure washed with water.
Chlorination of RCC internal surface by liquid chlorine.
The treated surface shall be dried using air jetting and all loose particles shall be removal from the surface.
Finally the surface shall be treated with ultraviolet radiation etc. as per direction of Engineer-in-Charge. ---- including cost and conveyance of all materials all lead and lift, loading and unloading, hire charges of machinery and equipments, transportation charges labour charges and all other incidental charges etc., complete as per standard technical detailed specification and as per approved design and drawing and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work.
